content:
**Crispy Cave Cricket** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Cave Cricket Meat that has been thinly sliced and cooked over a fire until crispy. It gives a 30 minute boost to Energy Resistance while restoring a moderate amount of HP and hunger at the cost of a moderate dose of rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Cave Cricket Meat | | Crispy Cave Cricket (1) | 

Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after having picked up cave cricket meat for the first time.
